about_the_game:
Impulse is a chaotic, physics-based party game where up to 4 players push, shove, race, and outmaneuver each other across a variety of ridiculous mini-games. Whether you’re knocking friends off a platform, scrambling up moving obstacles, or surviving a collapsing arena, one thing is certain — someone’s going to get launched into the void.

Play online or locally, master your momentum, and use perfectly-timed pushes to claim victory. Every match is quick, unpredictable, and guaranteed to spark laughter (and maybe some friendly grudges).

Key Features

  • 4 Player Mayhem – Jump in with friends locally or online.

  • Multiple Game Modes – Knockout battles, obstacle races, climbing challenges, and more.

  • Wacky Physics – Push, bump, and body-check your way to the top.

  • Easy to Learn, Hard to Master – Simple controls with plenty of room for skill.

  • Fast-Paced Rounds – Quick matches keep the energy high and the fun nonstop.

  • Laugh-Out-Loud Chaos – Perfect for parties, game nights, or online hangouts.

Whether you’re here to win or just to cause trouble, Impulse is all about fun, momentum, and the thrill of sending your friends flying.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: 4 Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 20 Series Card or AMD Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: 6-8 Core CPU
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 30 Series Card or AMD Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
